falsification.text: If genetic analysis reveals that the infantile form of free sialic acid storage disease is primarily caused by a gain-of-function mutation in SLC17A5, or if Sandhoff disease is caused by a gain-of-function mutation in HEXB, this hypothesis would be falsified.
